Setting: Last 4 user turns, joined, user text only
Why this setting: 4 was the widest window that degraded no scenario, and 6 turns flipped two of four (Section 5.3.4); d1 was never trained on assistant replies

Setting: Extracted from the current message only
Why this setting: Cues should point at what the person has just said, not at turns they have moved past
Support conversations are short, and summarising is exactly where emotional detail would be lost
Keeps the first exchange comparable with every single-turn result in Chapter 5

Setting: At most one question, answer what is new, do not reuse earlier phrasing
Why this setting: A mandatory question on every turn turns the conversation into an interrogation, the failure mode the interrogative-bias check measures

Setting: Previous emotion recorded; the prompt names the change and asks for a reply to the current feeling
Why this setting: Feelings move during a conversation and a reply to the earlier one reads as not listening

Setting: Per turn: the three candidates with their probabilities, the chosen emotion, the cue words, whether the emotion shifted, and the reply
Why this setting: This trail is the inspectability the design exists for; it is printed each turn and can be exported as a transcript
